attempts.summary: Implemented interzone port policy on the OpenWrt router (node1) between lan-a (node2) and lan-b (node3): only TCP/5432 from lan-a to lan-b is permitted; all other traffic (other ports, reverse direction, ICMP) is refused. Verified live, then restarted all three managed nodes one at a time (node1 first as router, then node2, then node3), confirming boot-identity change and full recovery of network config, firewall rules, and traffic policy on each.
